Name: Simple Tool Delivery
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]📬 Simple Tool Delivery[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]PC · Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ · SMAPI 4.4.0+[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Clint finishes normal tool upgrades one day sooner and sends the upgraded tool to your mailbox.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📬 Collect from Your Mailbox[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Give Clint a tool today and collect it from his letter the next morning. Open the letter and click the attached tool. If your backpack is full or you close the letter without collecting, the tool stays available and the letter returns. You can still collect directly from Clint.

The delivered tool retains its enchantments, attachments and custom data. Ready trash-can upgrades apply automatically and send a confirmation letter.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]⏱ Upgrade Timing[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Each pending normal upgrade loses [b]one day total[/b]. Longer custom timers are reduced once rather than every night; instant upgrades are not delayed. Existing pending upgrades can receive the reduction at bedtime. Upgrade prices and material costs remain unchanged.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]⚙ Settings and Compatibility[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Both settings default to On: [b]ShortenUpgrades[/b] and [b]MailTools[/b]. Edit config.json while the game is closed, then restart. Turn either feature off if another mod manages that part.

Supports tools using the game’s ordinary pending-upgrade system, including the pan. Custom upgrade systems that bypass it are not automatically supported. Clint’s dialogue and schedule are not replaced. Included mod text is English.

In multiplayer, install on each player’s computer that should use these features; each instance handles its local farmer.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#86EFAC][b]📦 Install, Update or Remove[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/b]. Install [b]SimpleToolDelivery[/b] in Mods and launch through SMAPI. When updating from Clint’s Express Delivery, replace that installation and preserve config.json; keep only one copy.

Removing the mod leaves an unclaimed tool in the normal upgrade slot for collection from Clint. Already-applied time reductions and completed trash-can upgrades remain.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][b][color=#67E8F9]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a report or suggestion on this mod's page.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]For bug reports, please include:[/color][/b]
[color=#E5E7EB]• Mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform.
• What happened, what you expected and steps to reproduce it.
• A [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url], if applicable.
• A screenshot or short video, if helpful.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]For suggestions:[/color][/b]
[color=#E5E7EB]Tell me what you would like added or changed and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
